description: Test suite for the 'codex-native-web-search' module, including functions for web search configuration, payload modification, and feature activation logic.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeWebSearchConfig
methods.description: Normalizes and constructs configuration for the native web search, including allowed domains and user location.

methods.name: buildCodexNativeWebSearchTool
methods.description: Builds the web search tool configuration object used in the native web search integration.

methods.name: patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload
methods.description: Modifies a given payload to inject the native web search tool if not already present.

methods.name: describeCodexNativeWebSearch
methods.description: Provides a description of the current native web search configuration, or returns undefined if disabled.

methods.name: resolveCodexNativeSearchActivation
methods.description: Determines whether the native Codex search is active, managed only, or inactive based on configuration and model context.

methods.name: shouldSuppressManagedWebSearchTool
methods.description: Indicates whether the managed web search should be suppressed when native Codex search is active.

methods.name: isCodexNativeWebSearchRelevant
methods.description: Checks if the specified model configuration makes native web search relevant.

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "function", name: "read" }] };$/

ctags.name: payload
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = { tools: [{ type: "web_search" }] };$/

ctags.name: result
ctags.pattern: /^    const result = patchCodexNativeWebSearchPayload({ payload, config: baseConfig });$/
